query: INSERT INTO projector_cursors (projector_name, last_seen_created_at, last_seen_event_id, updated_at) VALUES ('webhook_projector', $1, $2, $3) ON CONFLICT (projector_name) DO UPDATE SET last_seen_created_at = EXCLUDED.last_seen_created_at, last_seen_event_id = EXCLUDED.last_seen_event_id, updated_at = EXCLUDED.updated_at
